summary: Baby polar bear subtitle does not explicitly mention it comes from a baby polar bear
description:
## The bug

This is inconsistent with baby turtles, whose subtitles do actually specify this.

The expected subtitle in this case would be "Baby Polar Bear hurns".

## How to reproduce

/playsound minecraft:entity.polar_bear.ambient_baby master @a
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create and enter a Creative world with default settings.
3. Enter and run `/playsound minecraft:entity.polar_bear.ambient_baby master @a`.
4. Observe that the subtitle for the sound does not explicitly identify it as coming from a baby polar bear, instead of displaying “Baby Polar Bear hurns”.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.15.2, 20w21a, 20w22a, 1.16 Pre-release 1, 1.16 Pre-release 2, 1.16 Pre-release 3, 1.16 Pre-release 4, 1.16 Pre-release 5, 1.16 Pre-release 7, 20w28a, 20w29a, 20w30a, 1.16.2 Pre-release 1, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 20w45a, 20w46a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w10a, 21w15a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17, 1.17.1, 1.18 Pre-release 1, 1.18.1, 1.18.2, 22w11a, 1.19, 1.19.2, 1.19.3, 23w03a, 1.19.4, 23w14a, 1.20.1, 23w32a, 1.20.3 Release Candidate 1 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

When the command is executed, the baby polar bear sound plays, but its subtitle is displayed as **“Polar Bear hurns”**. The subtitle does not indicate that the sound originated from a baby polar bear.
Expected Behavior: When the baby polar bear ambient sound is played, the subtitle should explicitly identify its source as a baby polar bear, displaying “Baby Polar Bear hurns.” This would make the subtitle consistent with other baby-mob subtitles, such as those for baby turtles, rather than using a generic or non-specific polar bear sound description.
